translation: Pallavi (Chorus): Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela. Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela.

Verse 1: A man who won't even lift his right hand, one who just sits and gets by — a man who won't even lift his right hand, one who just sits and gets by — let's stay together with all our own caste-folk, Neela. Let's stay together with all our own caste-folk, Neela.

Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela. Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela.

Verse 2: Yours is a face like nine moons, what fault is there in my rubbing on the turmeric paste? Yours is a face like nine moons, what fault is there in my rubbing on the turmeric paste? Your words are gold, Neela, even when they scold me. Your words are gold, Neela, even when they scold me.

Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela. Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela.

Verse 3: On the path we take, there's a dispute among the herder folk, they say. On the path we take, there's a dispute among the herder folk, they say. Let's go and see it, Neela, let's go and settle it. Let's go and see it, Neela, let's go and settle it.

Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela. Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela.

Verse 4: The road we come and go on, the road of flirting glances — the road we come and go on, the road of flirting glances — you won't even hold my hand, and you mustn't even smile a little. You won't even hold my hand, and you mustn't even smile a little.

Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Curly, curly-haired one, how lovely your form is! Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela. Six yards of cloth bound together, let's live as one, Neela.
summaryEn: Ringu Ringu Yentikalayya ("Curly, Curly-Haired One") is a playful Telangana courtship song sung by Prabha, from the SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs album (2021), filed here under Romance. A young man addresses his beloved, called "Neela," admiring her curly hair and lovely face, and praising even her scolding words as golden. The refrain, repeated after every verse, reads like a marriage proposal — asking her to bind their lives together like the folds of a sari and live as one among their own community ("kulamolla," people of the same caste). The verses in between sketch scenes of everyday rural life: a lazy suitor who won't lift a hand to work, a dispute among the herder (Golla) community that the couple plans to go settle together, and a teasing complaint that she won't hold his hand or even smile at him on the road. The mood throughout is light, flirtatious, and affectionate, typical of a courtship song meant for singing and dancing at social gatherings, with its insistently repeated refrain carrying the rhythm from verse to verse.
summaryTe: రింగు రింగు యెంటికలయ్య అనేది తెలంగాణ యాసలో సాగే సరదా ప్రేమ పాట. దీన్ని ప్రభ పాడారు, ఇది 2021 నాటి SUPERHIT Telangana Folk Songs ఆల్బమ్‌లోనిది, రొమాన్స్ కేటగిరీలో చేర్చబడింది. ఒక యువకుడు తన ప్రేయసిని "నీలా" అని పిలుస్తూ, ఆమె ఉంగరాల జుట్టును, అందమైన మొహాన్ని, గద్దించే మాటలను సైతం బంగారంతో పోలుస్తూ పొగుడుతాడు. ప్రతి చరణం తర్వాత వచ్చే పల్లవి ఒక పెళ్లి ప్రతిపాదనలా అనిపిస్తుంది — చీర ముడి వేసినట్టు తమ జీవితాలను ఒకటిగా ముడివేసుకుని, తమ కులంవారితో కలిసి జీవిద్దామని కోరుకుంటాడు. మధ్యలో వచ్చే చరణాల్లో పనిచేయకుండా కూర్చుని బతికే సోమరి మనిషి ప్రస్తావన, గొల్ల కులస్తుల మధ్య తలెత్తిన తగాదాను వెళ్లి పరిష్కరిద్దామనే మాట, దారిలో చెయ్యి పట్టుకోనని, నవ్వనైనా నవ్వవని ఆమెపై సరదా ఫిర్యాదు కనిపిస్తాయి. మొత్తంగా ఇది తేలికైన, అల్లరి కలిసిన ఆప్యాయమైన పాట — సామాజిక కూడికలలో పాడుకుని నృత్యం చేసుకునేలా, పదే పదే వచ్చే పల్లవి లయను నడిపిస్తుంది.
